text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are, Cheval-chan! So this is 
where you were! I've been looking for you!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... Kita-san? W-What's the matter...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We're going to invite some friends and go 
hang out now. Would you like to come too, 
Cheval-chan?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Wait... hang out with everyone...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
“......S-Sorry. I... have something to 
take care of, so...”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see. If you've got things to do, it 
can't be helped. I'll invite you again, so 
let's hang out next time!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*... Why did I... do something 
like that...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I didn't have any errands at all... I 
lied...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...I should at least make up an errand 
now... yeah...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Right, I put off my singing practice... 
So today, I'll work hard on that—!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Cheval-chan?! Didn't you have 
something to take care of?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —Eep!? K-Kita-san...?!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, um... I-I was thinking of 
practicing singing... S-So, going to 
karaoke—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a coincidence! We were just 
about to head to karaoke, too!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, hey! Cheval, play with us too! I'll 
sing Turbo's songs for you a whole bunch!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (...How on earth did it come to this...!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, but I really want to practice. I 
wonder if I won't be able to concentrate 
if I'm with everyone else...?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I don't really wanna get in 
Cheval-chan's way either~...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... Kita-san is always so nice to me, 
and yet...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...I'm not good at making a fuss with 
everyone— but how I feel right now isn't a 
lie either!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
“...I-I'm fine...! I... I want to practice 
with everyone too...!”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Yay! Chevalier-chan is joining 
our karaoke party too!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...I-I have to make up for that lie... By 
giving it everything I've got...!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-What are we gonna do, what are we 
gonna dooo??

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Let's go!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You look like you're having fun, Cheval! 
Nice, nice, getting me all hyped too~! 
Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mumu... You're standing out more than 
Mar-chan. Please let Mar-chan sing next 
time.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! Let's hype things up today! 
Here we go, here we go, here we go, here 
we gooo!!

One day, I spotted Cheval Grand running 
along the track at incredible speed.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... ...W-Was that really 
okay...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I did try my best, but... B-But in the 
end, it's just me, so..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... um, Trainer. Actually...

"According to her, while thinking about 
various things for today's karaoke, she 
ended up running here."

guts.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...N-No, calling it 'enduring'... It 
wasn't something unpleasant like that at 
all..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Kita-san was always looking out for me... 
and everyone else too... T-That's why, I—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...T-That was fun...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. It was fun, it really was... I 
swear that's not a lie, but..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...That was harder than any training I've 
ever done...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? W-Was I really that fast...?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Huh. But... before I knew it... my 
legs...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...A-Ahaha... My knees are shaking so 
much... I guess I really ran that hard...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Because there are so many things I 
wanted to look back on..."
